title: skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md: rewrite the reserved word "role" to ADR-0090 D3 vocabulary, keeping one retirement note — the residue is what PR #15073 baselines
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon 13, session_01WXyGTWPbbreqXow7Z2pZCk) on the maintainer's ruling of 2026-09-04 on decision card #15075 (option B of the director's re-evaluation; verbatim reply in chat: 「按照你的建议，跟进并处理完这两个pr。」). Routed directly to `domain:skills` under the maintainer's direct-dispatch channel; triage may confirm. Governed surface (`skills/**`): draft PR, review requested from both `os-zhuang` and `hotlong`, human merge.

## Why

PR #15073 widens `check:role-word` to the published catalog's `references/` pages and reds on this page: 12 occurrences of the reserved word. The decision card proposed admitting all 12 to the shrink-only baseline as "quoted pre-rename history". Read line by line on `origin/main`, only part of that holds:

| lines | occurrences | what they are | disposition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 350 (table row) | 2 | the retirement note: `session.roles` retired in 17.0.0, never produced | **keep** (one retirement note is legitimate history) |
| 574-575 (comment) | 2 | the same retirement note again, plus "never by a role name" | fold into one sentence without the reserved word ("privilege is judged by the security service, never by a session claim") |
| 733 (example) | 1 | `where: { role: 'admin' }` querying a user field named `role` | rewrite the example to a real field or a permission-set check; no `sys_user` field is named `role` |
| 822 (callout) | 1 | "always hidden/masked for a role" | D3 vocabulary: "for a permission set or position" |
| 837-841 (comment) | 6 | the retirement note a third time, plus "role name", "role list", "role-aware", "per-role exemption" | keep the one useful warning (do not write `ctx.session?.roles?.includes`), spell the rest in D3 vocabulary |

Target: the page teaches permission sets / positions / business units, states the `session.roles` retirement once (the table row) and warns once against the `ctx.session?.roles` pattern; expected residue 3 to 4 occurrences, all quoted history. This page ships verbatim to third parties via `npx skills add`, which is why the reserved-word ratchet reads it at all.

## Definition of done

- The rewrite above, no other content change; the page's line and token ceilings under the skills ratchets respected (report the arithmetic).
- `node scripts/check-role-word.mjs` run on the branch with PR #15073's walker change applied locally (cherry-pick or the same two-line edit in a throwaway): the page's count reported; anything left is the retirement note and the warning.
- ⛔ Do not touch `scripts/role-word-baseline.json`; the baseline entry for the residue is PR #15073's, authorized by the maintainer on that PR.
- Draft PR, both approver accounts requested, human merge.

Blocks: #15073 (card #15061) — that PR lands after this page merges, with the baseline entry for the residue.

Refs: #15061 · PR #15073 · #15075 (ruling) · ADR-0090 D3.
